move: five phones fly into a 3D fan, sway, screens scroll, lift off
how: Over a slowly scaling ocean background five 250x540 phones (alternating light/dark UI) fly in from y:700 and 1.6x their final x with rotateY doubled and rotateX -20 to their fan positions (x -520..520, z -220..0, rotateY 28..-28), staggered 0.12s from the centre outward with 1.3s expo.out in the first 20% of the 10s duration. A caption fades up at 12%. The whole group then rotates rotateY -12 then +10 with two 3.6s sine.inOut segments (16-88%), while each phone's body scrolls y -120 then back to 0 with power3.inOut in a 0.18s wave. At 90% the phones lift to y:-750 with rotateX 25 and fade (expo.in) in reverse order and the title fades.
adapt: Change the five screen names, hero copy, gradient colours, the caption and the background image; the layout array controls the fan spread. Keep the 1.3s move entries, the 0.12s stagger and the 3.6s sine sway.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .grp with five phones from shot.screens; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entries at (0.01 + k*0.012)*D, sways at 0.16D/0.52D and the exit at 0.9D. The perspective is on .stage so el needs perspective:2200px and .grp preserve-3d; layout x values assume a 1280-wide frame.
caveats: full-frame background image scaled with a filter (brightness/saturate), moderately heavy
loop does not close: phones exit upward
